diagnosis: SystemNotice utilizes polymorphic inheritance for standard notices (MaintenanceNotice, ReleaseNotice) and confidential alerts (SecurityVulnerabilityNotice containing unpatched zero-day summaries). The endpoint retrieves the polymorphic model by notice_id without verifying whether the requesting user has SOC/Admin clearance when the instance resolves to a SecurityVulnerabilityNotice.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/notices/NOTIF-SEC-882/ HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.infrastructure.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_customer_token>
Accept: application/json
